faq.title: Everything you need to know before entrusting your search to Yallah Services.
faq.intro: Clear answers on our timeframes, replacement policy, placement contract and payment after validation.
faq.ctaText: Our Casablanca-based team replies directly on WhatsApp within 2 hours, 7 days a week.

delai-profil.question: How long does it take to receive a profile?
delai-profil.answer: As soon as we receive your request on WhatsApp, our team replies within 2 hours (7 days a week) to confirm the details of your need (chosen pack, live-in or live-out option, schedule, city). We then present verified, available profiles within an average of less than 24 hours.

politique-remplacement.question: What is your replacement policy in case of dissatisfaction?
politique-remplacement.answer: If, despite our screening, the selected person does not adapt to your household routine or job requirements, we arrange a replacement under the “Follow-up & Guarantee” formula chosen at placement ([À CONFIRMER : guarantee duration under Essential or Serenity formula]), with no additional search fees during the covered period.

paiement-apres-validation.question: When are the agency fees paid?
paiement-apres-validation.answer: No payment is ever requested in advance. Reviewing your need and presenting profiles is free of commitment. Agency placement fees are paid exclusively after you have validated the selected profile, never before.

contrat-placement.question: Is there a placement contract between the agency and the client?
contrat-placement.answer: Yes. Every validated placement is formalized by a written placement contract signed between Yallah Services and the client (household or company). It specifies the chosen pack, attendance mode (live-in or live-out), agreed salary, schedule and the subscribed follow-up and guarantee terms.

langues-parlees.question: What languages are spoken by the proposed staff?
langues-parlees.answer: Depending on the profile and position, shortlisted candidates speak Moroccan Arabic (Darija), French and/or English. During our initial chat on WhatsApp, simply tell us your preferred everyday language so we can present profiles who communicate comfortably with your household.

zones-couvertes.question: Which areas and cities are covered in Morocco?
zones-couvertes.answer: Based in Casablanca, Yallah Services operates across 11 cities in Morocco: Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Fez, Tangier, Agadir, Meknes, Oujda, Kenitra, Sale and Tetouan, as well as their residential neighbourhoods and surrounding towns (Bouskoura, Anfa, Souissi, Hay Riad, Hivernage, Palmeraie…).
